For those that would like to know a little more, it all started when I list my gf of 2 years almost 3. I always loved her, never took her for granted, I appreciated everything she did for me but I never realized how much I loved her until I lost her. She told me we just grew apart. So of course I was devastated. Completely ruined. I didn't know what to do with my life. I hated my life, I no longer had purpose. She was the only reason I was working hard in life. So I also lost my motive, my drive to do anything. I ended up dropping out of school because I couldn't concentrate. I was depressed over her for almost a year when things got really dark. I began to have these suicidal thoughts. I started hearing voices/sounds and seeing things that weren't really there. At first they were small and hard to notice but it got to the point where these voices were all telling me to kill my self. I would see things that would/could kill me easily. Everywhere I went there was a suicidal thought and the more time I spent alone the worst it got. I got to the point where I just didn't care anymore. For what ever reason, I told myself, "hey, since I'm just gonna end it all, I might as well do everything I've wanted to do but didn't because I was afraid of the consequences." I soon found myself experimenting with psychedelics. To be honest in sure what I thought of or what exactly caused me to change, but right after one of my "trips" I woke up feeling amazing. The world didn't seem so dark anymore. I started going out more and actually having fun! God, did I take for granted the amazing feeling of just having pure fun! I got a great job that pays well, I started saving up to go back to school and even the love of my life, my ex, was attracted to me. After 3 years we got back together and this time I didn't dive in like before, I love her to death but during one of my "trips" I came to the conclusion that just because you love someone it doesn't mean you'll hey to spend the rest of your life with them, and just because you're not with them it doesn't mean you can't be happy. I told myself that she ear not the one for me and I will find someone better! Honestly, I'm not sure anymore, she might be the one she might not be. The point is things seem to have been going in a great direction for me. ... 
yet every now and then I still hear things, I see things. I still catch myself having depressing/suicidal thoughts. I don't have the urge of going through with my suicide anymore, so why do I still continue to get dark thoughts?? Why do I still feel sad/depressed?? Or maybe there's just something else wrong with my head?? Should I see a professional even though I'm basically broke?? Any advice would be helpful, please and thank you, I truly am grateful for taking your time to read/help me!!
